question: What will be the percentage change in the US dollar to Brazilian real exchange rate (USDBRL=X on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-06 to the close on 2026-09-04?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-09-04 / close on 2026-08-06 - 1), using daily closes of USDBRL=X on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-09-04, the last close before it is used.

Target date 2026-09-04 is 21 trading observations ahead. Percentiles of the price on the target date,
from the empirical distribution of 21-observation returns over the last 3 years (last year weighted double):
p5: 4.8969, p10: 4.9441, p25: 5.0209, p50: 5.1166, p75: 5.2161, p90: 5.2973, p95: 5.3504

(exchange, contract month, close vs settlement price).
research:
I couldn't open the resolution page, but on 2026-08-06 USD/BRL closed at about R$ 5.105-5.107, per Brazilian press. Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. Yahoo Finance, financenews.com.br, dgabc.com.br and blog.daycoval.com.br all refused the connection through the proxy, so I took their figures from search-result summaries. My searches also turned up many pages dated after 2026-08-07, and I left all of them out as instructed.

## 1. Resolution source
- I could not reach the Yahoo Finance USDBRL=X history page, so I can't report Yahoo's own 2026-08-06 close. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/USDBRL=X/history/)
- 2026-08-06: The spot dollar fell about 0.41-0.44% to roughly R$ 5.105-5.107. DGABC gives selling at R$ 5.1073. [DGABC](https://www.dgabc.com.br/Noticia/4339794/fechamento-do-mercado-financeiro), [Finance News](https://financenews.com.br/2026/08/ibovespa-fecha-em-123-dolar-cai-a-r-510/)
- 2026-08-06: The PTAX rate was 5.1011 (buying) and 5.1017 (selling). [Ipeadata](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38590&module=M)
- Yahoo's USDBRL=X close is often a bit different from the B3 spot close, because Yahoo records the price at a different time. The baseline is probably about 5.10-5.11.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The window runs about 21 trading days, from 2026-08-06 to 2026-09-04.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-06: The Ibovespa fell 1.23% to 175,546 while the dollar dropped about 0.44%. [Finance News](https://financenews.com.br/2026/08/ibovespa-fecha-em-123-dolar-cai-a-r-510/)
- 2026-08-05: The Copom cut the Selic rate by 25 bp to 14.00%, unanimously. It was the fourth cut in a row, and the statement made no commitment about the next move. Before the decision, the Focus survey expected 13.75% by end-2026. That morning the dollar traded near R$ 5.116. [CNN Brasil](https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/economia/money/macroeconomia/bc-copom-agosto-2026/), [Orion](https://orionresearch.com.br/noticias/copom-corta-selic-14-comunicado-agosto-2026/), [Mercado Hoje](https://mercadohoje.uai.com.br/2026/08/05/dolar-hoje-05-08-2026-veja-as-informacoes-da-moeda-americana)
- 2026-07-31: The dollar closed at R$ 5.069, down 1.82% in July and about 7.7% year to date. Supporting the real: high oil prices, foreign inflows and carry-trade demand. Working against it: Middle East tension and rising US Treasury yields. In July the dollar went from above R$ 5.20 early in the month to about R$ 5.07. [Agência Brasil](https://agenciabrasil.ebc.com.br/economia/noticia/2026-07/dolar-fecha-estavel-mas-acumula-queda-de-182-em-julho), [SouBrasília](https://soubrasilia.com/dolar-queda-julho-2026-fechamento-cotacao/)
- So between 07-31 and 08-06 the dollar rose about 0.7% (5.069 to about 5.105).
- 2026-07-24: A Datafolha poll had Lula ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro 48% to 43% in a runoff, and 40% to 32% in the first round. [O Povo](https://www.opovo.com.br/noticias/politica/eleicoes/2026/07/24/pesquisa-datafolha-de-presidente-com-lula-e-flavio-bolsonaro.html)

## 4. Base rates
- BRL usually has an implied or realized volatility of about 10-14% a year. That works out to a 1-sigma move of roughly 3-4% over about 21 trading days, with fat tails. This is my general background knowledge, not a sourced figure.
- 2026 monthly moves were modest: about -1.8% in July, with the year-to-date fall of about -7.7% spread over seven months. Monthly moves of more than ±4% have mostly come with shocks, such as March 2020 or the fiscal scares of late 2024.
- Trend: the real has strengthened steadily through 2026. Election pre-campaign periods have historically pushed USD/BRL higher (2002, 2018, 2022).

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on USD/BRL for this window.
- 2026-07-27: The Focus median for end-2026 was R$ 5.20, about 2% above the 08-06 close. Focus measures the December average rate. [Diario de Pernambuco](https://www.diariodepernambuco.com.br/economia/2026/07/11719637-dolar-no-fim-de-2026-segue-em-rs-520-projeta-focus.html)
- Daycoval Bank's August outlook projected a R$ 5.10-5.20 range for the month. I only saw this in a search summary; the page itself wouldn't load. [Daycoval](https://blog.daycoval.com.br/doalr-agosto26/)

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-09-04
- About Aug 11-12: US July CPI and Brazil July IPCA inflation.
- Mid-August: The official election campaign starts (usually Aug 16), followed by new Datafolha and Quaest polls. Free TV and radio campaign advertising starts in late August. The first round is Oct 4.
- About Aug 20-22: The Fed's Jackson Hole symposium, with Powell or his successor likely signalling the path for the September FOMC.
- Late August: Brazil's 2027 budget bill (PLOA) is due by Aug 31, which is a fiscal-risk test. The month-end PTAX fixing on Aug 31 can cause technical moves.
- About Sep 1: Brazil Q2 GDP.
- Sep 4: The US August payrolls report is out the morning of the resolution day.
- Ongoing: US-Iran and Middle East tension, and oil prices (Brazil is a net oil exporter).
- Outside the window: Copom meets Sep 15-16 and the FOMC in mid-September.
